text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Bubble Gum Fellow got injured during training,
so I brought her to the infirmary.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Man, this is tough...
And here I thought I did a thorough warm-up.
choice_data_list: I'm sorry, I should have been more careful.
Sorry, I should've paid more attention.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
You're not to blame,
it was simply my mistake.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Besides, look, as you can see, it's no big deal of an injury. Don't look so grave.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
I barely even feel any pain, so it's totally fine
if I jump right back into it now.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Trust me.
If it doesn't work out, we can think about it then.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: "At times like this, I push forward without hesitation. You know that, right?"
choice_data_list: Even so, you should rest for now.
Even so, you should rest for now.
Got it. Just don't overdo it.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: "At times like this, I push forward without hesitation. You know that, right?"
choice_data_list: Even so, you should rest for now.
Even so, you should rest for now.
Got it. Just don't overdo it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Even mild symptoms shouldn't be taken lightly. I convinced her that resting is by no means taking a step backward.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
"...You're so calm. Well, I suppose that's why
you're able to handle being a Trainer."

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Understood, I think I'll take
a proper rest this time.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
All right... Sigh, I suddenly have time
to spare. What should I do...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Letting out a sigh, Bubble Gum Fellow headed back to the dorm.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Alright! Now that that's settled,
let's get right back to training!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: ...*pant*... *gasp*.
choice_data_list: Are you trying to tough it out even though you're hurting?

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
...!
Guess pushing myself too hard really wasn't the right call.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
It didn't feel that bad right after I got hurt,
but honestly, it's starting to throb pretty hard now.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: That's it for training, then...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Bubble Gum Fellow worsened her injury.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Alright, if I mix in stretches like this...

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Just as I thought, looks like you're doing fine.
Don't overdo it, but let's keep moving!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Gradually easing her body back into shape,
Bubble Gum Fellow made a smooth return.
